entries.en: the waist, the loins; the hips, haunches
entries.notes: L 的 caderas 本指胯臀，H/M 明示 腰；R 栏对音 yân 与 腰 常读不合。

entries.en: the bones of the waist, the lumbar bones; the hips
to fall; to descend, to go down
to fall down
entries.notes: R 栏 hīn hiā 与 墜下 对音不合，语义据 H/M/L 三栏一致定。

entries.en: to fall, to stumble, to trip
entries.notes: L 栏 baqsear ychar ychabafo 漫漶不可解，据 H=跌、R=tīe 定。

entries.zh: 跌着；跌倒（跌而触地、受伤）
entries.en: to fall onto something; to have a fall, to be hurt by falling
entries.notes: R 栏首音 pōant 与 H=跌 不合（疑 绊/跋 之属），H 与 M 仍明示跌着。

entries.en: to fall down, to tumble
to fall from a horse
entries.notes: M 栏 guă lŏ bĕ 后标[残]，语义由 L caer del caballo 与 H 跌落馬下 确定，R 栏对音亦不整。

entries.zh: 啄；鸟自上而下啄食、啄击
entries.en: to peck; (of a bird) to strike downward with the beak
entries.notes: L 栏 ut supra el papa 不可解（疑 el papo 鸟喉囊 之讹），语义据 H=啄 与 M=tôy 定。

entries.en: to peck a hole; to swoop down and wound with the beak
entries.notes: L 偏指扑击致伤、H 啄成空 偏指啄孔，两栏语义错位，取折中义。

entries.en: to fall; to fall down, to topple
to topple and fall; to fall down
to overturn, to turn over; to fall over
entries.notes: M 栏末 cos 不可解（该处 T99 污损），语义据 H=翻 与 L=caerse 定。

entries.en: to fling off, to shed; (of leaves) to drop off
entries.notes: L 栏末 anblaya enclaya 漫漶，主句 caerse la hoja del arbol 与 H=甩 清楚。

entries.en: (of a leaf) to drop into the water
to drop off, to fall (of leaves)
to fall and scatter; (of leaves) to wither and drop
entries.notes: M 栏窜入 Lao ta caunc 残片（T99），疑他条混入；H/R 零落 明确。

entries.en: trees shed their leaves; the leaves fall from the trees
to wither, to fade (of leaves and flowers)
to wither and fall
to wither and fall away; to decline, to dwindle
